title: German Sirloin Steak with Pan-Seared Quenched Potatoes
description: A classic German dish featuring a tender sirloin steak paired with pan-seared quenched potatoes. This recipe showcases the rich flavors of Germany's culinary heritage.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the sirloin steak with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Add 1-2 tablespoons of saudi oil to the preheated skillet.
Sear the sirloin steak for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the steak to a plate and let it rest.
Increase the heat to high and add the remaining 1-2 tablespoons of saudi oil to the skillet.
Add the quenched potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Serve the pan-seared potatoes alongside the sirloin steak.
